name: SQL Execute
description: Executes a SQL DDL or DML statement (CREATE TABLE, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP) against a named database. 'db' names a venue-local convex-db database (per-user, lattice-backed, created on first use) or an operator-registered JDBC connection. Use params with ? placeholders for values. Requires the sql/execute ability on the database — reads and writes are separately grantable.

statement.description: SQL DDL/DML statement, optionally with ? placeholders
